findings.title: Support bundle drops source-query error/retained/freshness/paused state

citations.source: const { data: version, isLoading: versionLoading } = useVersionInfo()
const { data: health, isLoading: healthLoading } = useSystemHealth()

findings.mechanism: Version/health query results are reduced to data/isLoading; SystemSummaryBrief always receives available, without source error, timestamps or retained/paused presentation. Bundle construction can succeed with partial/unknown or stale source fields. Available construction is not proven healthy/fresh backend state.
findings.sourceOnlyRepro: Trace a query initial error (undefined data, loading false) and a retained refresh error (old data, loading false): neither error survives the returned hook object nor reaches the summary. This is branch tracing only, no query/API action.
findings.ownerNeed: N1: useSupport + SupportBundlePanel narrow trust-state projection/presentation; preserve redacted partial bundle and disclose unknown/retained/error/pause independently.
findings.limit: Native behavior NOTRUN; this is a source mechanism, not a measured visual/runtime failure.

findings.title: Help config and generated page-summary keys are absent from canonical English
findings.mechanism: Actual t(configKey,fallback) consumers and dynamic helpIndex.page.<route.name>.summary requests refer to missing canonical leaves. All precise keys/sites are catalogAudit.missing; English fallback is available, so this is catalog maintenance/locale readiness, not broken baseline English.
